68: Gemara. We choose the textual variant: "And he shall say to the woman” [Numbers 5:19] -- in any language that she understands [Sifrei Bamidbar 12:1]; the Sifrei derives it from this verse. We do not choose the textual variant "And the priest shall say to the woman" [Numbers 5:21].
To the woman - implying, words that enter her heart -- that she should understand the language.
